info.title: ROF LMS API
info.description:
Rwanda Olympiad Foundation Learning Management System — Mathematics.

Authenticate with POST /api/v1/auth/login, then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.
Errors always have the shape `{ statusCode, error, code, message, details?, requestId }`.

Every operation states who may call it (`x-roles`). Beyond the role, records are scoped: students see their own work and their division's published content; mentors their assigned course × division scopes and the submissions assigned to them.

promoteStudents.description: Move every active student up one grade (true at the start of a new school year).

deactivateGraduates.description: When promoting, deactivate S6 students who graduate (default true).

gradeLevel.description: Correct the student's grade in the current year (moves division if needed).

status.description: WITHDRAWN ends the enrolment and suspends the account.

gradeLevel.description: S1–S3 places the student in the Junior division, S4–S6 in Senior.

schoolName.description: Name of the school attended. Normalised to Title Case and de-duplicated.

schoolLocation.description: City / region where the school is located.

refreshToken.description: Optional when the refresh token is sent as the httpOnly cookie.

password.description: Required for invitations; omitted for e-mail verification.

gradeLevel.description: Required for students; determines the division.

username.description: Optional; generated from the e-mail address when omitted.

gradeLevel.description: Required for students (S1–S6); determines the division.

schoolName.description: … or a school name (created if new, normalised to Title Case).

gradeLevel.description: Changing the grade moves a student to the matching division.

isActive.description: false suspends the account immediately (all sessions are revoked).

isApproved.description: Approve a student or mentor waiting for approval.

divisionId.description: Which division (Junior/Senior) this material is for.

sortOrder.description:
Display order within the course (lower number = shown first).
Defaults to 0 when not supplied.

author.description: Author(s) of a book, or who prepared the material.

source.description: Publisher, or the competition/exam a past paper comes from (e.g. "IMO").

year.description: Publication year, or the year of the exam.

year.description: Publication year, or the year of the exam.

sortOrder.description: Display order on course lists (lower first).

discussionsEnabled.description: Turn the course's discussions on or off (existing threads stay readable).

divisionId.description: Junior or Senior — the mentor must be assigned to this course × division.

description.description: Short summary shown in lists (the full brief goes in instructions).

deadline.description: ISO-8601 datetime for the submission deadline.

points.description: Leaderboard points available; awarded in proportion to the score.

maximumMarks.description: Ceiling for mentor scores. All submitted scores are validated against this.

allowResubmission.description: Whether students may resubmit before the deadline (while not yet under review).

allowLateSubmission.description: Accept first submissions after the deadline (flagged as late).

description.description: Short summary shown in lists (the full brief goes in instructions).

note.description: Optional reason, kept in the assignment history.
Optional reason, kept in the assignment history.

deadline.description: New deadline (ISO-8601). Required when the current one has passed.

assignmentId.description: The published assignment being submitted to.

answerText.description: The student's typed answer for this attempt.

note.description: Optional note from the student about this submission/revision.

mentorId.description: Must be a mentor assigned to the assignment's course × division.

mentorFeedback.description: Formal academic feedback shown to the student once results are published.

note.description: What the student should change. Shown to the student.

dueAt.description:
When the new attempt is due (ISO-8601, within 60 days). Defaults to the
assignment deadline or 7 days from now, whichever is later.

mentorIds.description:
Restrict distribution to these mentors. Omit to use every mentor assigned
to the assignment's course × division.

idempotencyKey.description:
Idempotency key supplied by the caller.
Re-submitting the same key returns the existing job rather than
dispatching duplicate messages. Use a UUID or a stable hash.

recipientUserIds.description:
Required when recipientMode is EXPLICIT.
Maximum 500 recipients per request.

recipientRole.description:
Required when recipientMode is ROLE.
Valid values: STUDENT | MENTOR | ADMIN

body.description:
Plain-text message body.
HTML is intentionally not supported to reduce XSS risk and simplify
the implementation. Add HTML support here when needed.

divisionId.description: Course threads posted by mentors/admins: which division. Ignored for students.

content.description:
The comment body. 1–2000 characters.
Trimmed before storage.

parentId.description:
If set, this comment is a reply to the specified parent comment in the
same thread. Only one level of nesting is supported.

action.description: HIDE or DELETE the item, LOCK a thread, or NONE to dismiss the report.

provider.description: Detected from the link when omitted; must match the link when given.

meetingUrl.description: External meeting link (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams …). https only.

date.description: Day of the session, YYYY-MM-DD (programme time zone).

startTime.description: Start time, HH:mm (24-hour, programme time zone).

endTime.description: End time, HH:mm (24-hour) on the same day.
